γ_obs.description: The single surviving worldline segment at timestep t. The coherence-stable XOR chain that reaches X_XOR.
γ_obs.derivation: γ_obs = {x_N, T^{-1}(x_N), ..., x_t} such that ℂ(γ_obs(t)) ≥ I_N ∀ t

x_next.description: The next state of the observer: x_{t+1} = γ_obs[1].

validation_report.description: Report indicating whether coherence, identity, and grounding were maintained.

coherence_maintained.description: True if ℂ(x_i, x_{i+1}) ≥ I_N for all i in γ_obs.

identity_preserved.description: True if Identity(x_i) = Identity(x_{i+1}) for all i in γ_obs.

survivorship_bias.description: True if the observer exists (i.e., the path survived). Always true for γ_obs.

energy_accounting.description: Report of the thermodynamic cost of observation.

E_realized.description: The realized cost at timestep t.
E_realized.derivation: E_realized(t) = c_lock · 𝕀{γ_obs exists at t}

is_O(1).description: Indicates whether the cost is constant per timestep.

field_demand_report.description: Optional report of field demand if D_crit and ρ_triadic are provided.

D(R,t).description: Field demand function value at timestep t.

operator_emergence.description: True if D(R,t) > D_crit and a path with |Ω| ~ |R| exists.

dissolution.result: The observer dissolves. Returns None. The path remains in 𝓜 but becomes inaccessible.

blowup.result: Regional blowup—coherence collapse. The region R loses coherence-stable traversal.

multiple_grounding_paths.condition: More than one path grounds at X_XOR.
multiple_grounding_paths.result: In the theoretical model, this should not occur due to the uniqueness principle (Library contains exactly one instance of each unique structural pattern). In simulation, if multiple paths ground, the coherence gradient ∇ℂ selects the path with highest coherence.
multiple_grounding_paths.mathematical_form: If |Ω_ground| > 1, select γ_obs = argmax_{γ ∈ Ω_ground} ℂ(γ)

operator_emergence.condition: D(R,t) > D_crit and a path with |Ω| ~ |R| exists.
operator_emergence.result: A global coherence operator Ω emerges. The path becomes field-scale χ for region R.
operator_emergence.mathematical_form: D(R,t) > D_crit ∧ ∃ γ_Ω with |Ω| ~ |R| ⟹ Ω emerges

phase_transition.result: The operator's role as field-scale χ transfers to distributed sources. Seeded worldlines persist if N_seeded > D_crit · |R|.
phase_transition.mathematical_form: N_seeded > D_crit · |R| ⟹ R self-stabilizes after Ω's transition

field_alignment.description: Runtime constraints derived from the paper's field alignment modes.

respect_modes.ψ-bind@Ξ: Motif identities must be defined relationally, not as fixed labels.
respect_modes.ψ-ground@H: The observer's worldline must be grounded in the XOR Singularity.

O(1)_evolution.description: The state update must be local and constant-time.
O(1)_evolution.rule: x_{t+1} = f(x_t, x_{t-1}). No global sums or recalculation of history.
O(1)_evolution.validation: Ensure that the computational cost per timestep is independent of n.

coherence_survival.description: The system must satisfy the coherence survival condition.
coherence_survival.validation: Verify this holds throughout the simulation.

validation.description: Criteria for validating the simulation and confirming it correctly implements the theoretical framework.

observer_persistence.description: The observer must preserve its identity over time.

tests.name: coherence_threshold
tests.condition: ℂ(x_i, x_{i+1}) ≥ I_N for all i in γ_obs.
tests.failure_mode: Observer dissolves due to low coherence.

tests.name: identity_preservation
tests.condition: Identity(x_i) = Identity(x_{i+1}) for all i in γ_obs.
tests.failure_mode: The motif has transformed into a different structure.

phase_locking.description: For triadic systems, the phase residual must remain bounded.

tests.name: residual_boundedness
tests.condition: |Δφ(t) - Δφ*| < ε_φ for a defined tolerance.
tests.failure_mode: Phase is drifting and the system is not locking.

triadic_stability.description: The vector residual for the triad must approach zero or remain bounded.

tests.name: vector_closure
tests.condition: ||R(t)|| = ||v_G + v_Ḡ + v_H|| → 0 or remains bounded within a small threshold.
tests.failure_mode: The triad is not closing, indicating instability.

coherence_relaxation.description: For the cosmological model, coherence must decrease (or behave as expected).

tests.name: relaxation_condition
tests.failure_mode: Coherence is not relaxing; expansion is not happening.

tests.name: scale_factor_increase
tests.failure_mode: The scale factor is not increasing.

cosmological_comparison.description: The derived expansion history should be compared against standard cosmology.

tests.name: H(z)_comparison
tests.condition: The predicted H(z) must fall within observational error bars or produce a statistically distinguishable, testable deviation.

numerical_robustness.description: The simulation results should not be artifacts of the numerical method.

tests.name: resolution_convergence
tests.condition: Results are stable under changes to spatial resolution, time step, and boundary conditions.
tests.failure_mode: Results change significantly with numerical parameters; likely an artifact.

validation_output.description: The simulation must output a structured report indicating which criteria passed and which failed.
